blocks.text: The AI Security AI model scanner is a command-line tool used to scan machine learning models for security risks before deployment. To use the AI model scanner, you must first add an integration and generate an API key in the AI Security Admin Portal. This API key authenticates the model scanner and allows it to send the scan results back to AI Security for analysis.
On the Administration > Model Scan Management page, you can:

blocks.item: Add an Integration and Generate an API Key
Select the Integration Registration tab and click Add Integration.
See image.
The Add Integration drawer appears.
In the Add Integration drawer:
Integration Name: Enter a name for the integration.
Click Save.
Under API Key Management, click Generate Key. An API key is generated and displayed.
This API key is required to authenticate the scanner and is not recoverable. Copy the API key and store it in a secure location.
See image.
Download the AI Model Scanner
Select the Scanner Download tab.
Click the Download icon for the scanner binary appropriate for your operating system and save the file in your local folder.
Use the downloaded scanner binary to configure the AI model scanner.
See image.

blocks.text: To edit an integration and regenerate the API key if it has been exposed, lost, or for periodic credential rotation:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Model Scan Management.
On the Integration Registration tab, click Actions (⋮), and select Edit for the required integration.
See image.
The Edit Integration window appears.
In the Edit Integration window:
Integration Name: Update the integration name if needed.
Click Regenerate Key to generate a new API key.
A new API key is generated.
The regenerated API key invalidates the existing API key. Copy the new API key, store it in a secure location, and update all environments or scripts where the old API key was used.
See image.
Go to Administration > Model Scan Management.
On the Integration Registration tab, click Actions (⋮), and select Delete for the required integration.
See image.
The Delete Integration confirmation window appears.
In the Delete Integration confirmation window, read the message, and then enter CONFIRM in the text box.
See image.
Click Delete.

blocks.text: The registered integration is deleted from the AI Security Admin Portal.
